0022600032.text: The Trail Blazers (6-1, first in the Northwest and first in the West, on a three-game win streak) visit the Lakers (7-2, first in the Pacific and second in the West, also on a three-game streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, Portland's eighth of the season. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), all listed as out. The Trail Blazers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
